title: Amazon reportedly pays $120 million to stream the Emmys for free
summary: The Emmys have a new home - and it looks like Amazon paid plenty for the rights. The awards show and Amazon announced a six-year deal that will move the Emmys from its traditional broadcast television home to Prime Video.
